summary.text: Alex McMenemy, a Green Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the open 38th District to Jon Bonck.
Little other biographical information is publicly available.

paragraphs.text: McMenemy advanced from the Green Party convention for the 38th District on March 14, 2026, and completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2025.
In that survey he names homelessness as the issue he is personally most passionate about.
In his Ballotpedia survey he said his campaign called for free universal health care, a $20 minimum wage, stronger unions and environmental protections, ending ICE, and ending foreign wars.
He received 1.1% of the vote to Jon Bonck's 51.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
